content.text:
I've scrolled through the table and flicked to the bottom of the page. Here's my pick.

**What I'd tell a friend:** I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track. I'm fairly sure about it, not totally. What decided it was that it's the S&P thing everyone at work talks about, Harel is a name I know from ads, and it was the first one I saw. It shows 0.56% (that sounded like nothing) and 13.7% for 3 years. It also had "2.3 מיליארד ₪" next to it, so loads of people are already in it. The page didn't recommend anything, so I chose for myself.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" was already highlighted, and there was a button "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12". The line said fees go "מ־0.5% עד 0.73%", so they're all about the same.
- **Harel's rows.** I stopped on "עוקב מדד S&P 500": 0.56%, "13.7% 3 שנים", "11.92% 5 שנים". Just above it, "מניות" showed 24.04%, which is bigger. I hesitated, but S&P is what I came for.
- **The other companies.** I scrolled past Mor, Analyst and Meitav, plus a couple of companies whose names had already scrolled off the top. Analyst's "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" said 26.39% and almost pulled me in. I don't know what "גמיש" means, and I trust Harel more, so I passed. There was also one S&P row at 0.54%, but its company name had already scrolled off the top, so I didn't go for it.
- **The rest.** After about screen 8 I just flicked down to the bottom to see if there was a "we recommend" box. There wasn't, only rows marked "עוד לא דווח" with orange "!" icons. Those scared me off.

**What I skipped:** I didn't read the grey text at the bottom, the "?" icons, "חוקים וכללים", "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה", or the search box.

**Words and numbers I didn't get:**
- "ההפקדות 0%": is that a second fee, or is it free?
- "מט"ח 99%"
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" sitting where a number should be
- "ממוצע 2025"
- "גמיש"
- "חדש"
- The round circles. I guessed a fuller circle means more in shares.

**Where I got lost or bored:** Around screen 4 to 5. It's 143 rows that all look the same, with tiny differences like 0.56 against 0.58. It's laid out like a wide computer table, so on my phone on the bus I'd have given up and closed it. If I didn't have to choose today, I'd have done nothing.

**What I'd change:**
- Put the fee in shekels for my 30,000 ₪, not as percent.
- Show the S&P tracks side by side on their own.
- Have one line that tells a beginner where to start.
- Fix the rows with no number in them.
